summary: Database setup keeps working on its own, and a missing Defender licence no longer fails reports.

fixes.title: Database setup keeps its own access
fixes.text: Database setup keeps working after every update without anyone granting rights again.

fixes.title: Admin group changes are proven or rolled back
fixes.text: Moving the database admin to another group is proven by a real sign-in, and rolled back automatically when that fails.

fixes.title: Reports show not applicable without Defender licence
fixes.text: A report whose Defender data is not in your tenant, for example without Defender vulnerability management, shows as not applicable again. A real report problem is still shown as failed.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Updates keep pages fast in the background, and setup lines reach your log workspace.
